item.title: Knicks win NBA Cup after rallying to beat Spurs 124-113
item.description: LAS VEGAS (AP) — It's been more than half a century since the Knicks hung an NBA championship banner inside Madison Square Garden.

item.title: Celebrini's jaw-dropping goal helps Sharks beat Flames 6-3
item.description: SAN JOSE, Calif. (AP) — Macklin Celebrini scored a jaw-dropping goal and added an empty-netter and two assists to become the fastest San Jose player to reach 50 points in a season as the Sharks beat the Calgary Flames 6-3 on Tuesday night.

item.title: Haunted house and invisible demons: Tennessee Williams' early radio play 'The Strangers' publishes
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Long before the rise of podcast dramas , listeners worldwide tuned in to the audio-only narratives of radio plays.

item.title: Spurs got an education down the stretch in NBA Cup title game loss to Knicks
item.description: LAS VEGAS (AP) — For San Antonio, the NBA Cup final was an education. A painful education. The Spurs let an 11-point third quarter lead slip away and then some on Tuesday night, falling to the New York Knicks 124-113 in the Cup championship game.

item.title: Head of Via Rail to step down in January as Canada pursues high-speed rail
item.description: OTTAWA — Canada's transport minister says the head of Via Rail will leave his post next month in a move that comes as the federal government unveils its plans to pursue high-speed rail projects.

item.title: Funerals for people slain in Australian antisemitic mass shooting begin as suspected gunman charged
item.description: SYDNEY (AP) — A suspected gunman in Sydney’s Bondi Beach massacre was charged with 59 offenses including 15 charges of murder on Wednesday, as hundreds of mourners gathered in Sydney to begin funerals for the victims.

item.title: Vancouver Island's balmy December set for a cooldown
item.description: Record-breaking temperatures in the teens will give way to more seasonal daytime highs around 7 C and overnight lows of 2 to 3 C.
